label: the histogram counts linear values, not the sRGB values of the buffer it is given
find: let h = try Histogram(of: buffer, bins: HistogramBins.binCount, encoding: .sRGB)
replace: let h = try Histogram(of: buffer, bins: HistogramBins.binCount, encoding: .linear)

label: the turn is skipped: a straightened crop cuts the upright pixels
Saturation runs twice: once among the sliders, once after the curve
Exposure runs twice: in the sliders' list and the shared list
the shared list's steps are dropped: levels, the curve and saturation never run
the frame is taken from the buffer's sides swapped
Saturation still waits on creative-core
replace:
.vibrance: "Vibrance waits on creative-core (CoreRaster vibrance)",
        .saturation: "Saturation waits on creative-core (CoreRaster saturation)",

label: the turned crop turns the other way
find: AffineMatrix(a: c, b: s, c: -s, d: c,
replace: AffineMatrix(a: c, b: -s, c: s, d: c,

label: every band reads the frame's top rows
